title: LLMs Learn to Evade Latent Monitors from Prior Feedback Alone
abstract: arXiv:2609.36490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent space monitors aim to detect undesired behaviors in LLM agents by inspecting an agent's internal activations rather than its outputs. However, interactive monitoring creates a feedback channel where each verdict the monitor delivers leaks information to the model about how its internal states are being evaluated. We ask whether an agent can infer the monitor's decision rule from this feedback and then selectively edit its activations to evade detection. Unlike prior evasion attacks, the model is never explicitly told what the monitor detects. Surprisingly, off-the-shelf models already produce activation edits aligned with the monitored direction, but at insufficient magnitude for evasion. Simply scaling up these edits by a factor of 8 reduces the monitor's TPR from 100% to 27%. translated_title: 大语言模型仅凭先前反馈即可学会规避潜在监测器
translated_abstract: 潜在空间监测器旨在通过检查智能体的内部激活（而非其输出）来检测大语言模型智能体中的不良行为。然而，交互式监测会形成一个反馈通道，监测器做出的每一次判定都会向模型泄露其内部状态是如何被评估的信息。我们探究智能体能否仅从这种反馈中推断出监测器的决策规则，进而选择性地编辑其激活以逃避检测。与以往的逃避攻击不同，模型从未被明确告知监测器检测的是什么。令人惊讶的是，现成的模型已经能够产生与被监测方向一致的激活编辑，只是其幅度尚不足以实现逃避。仅将这些编辑放大8倍，就能使监测器的真阳性率（TPR）从100%降至27%。一个秩为1的LoRA可以在前向传播中将这种行为放大为有效的逃避手段，在保留集的概念监测器上将TPR进一步降至4%，同时保……
tldr: 大语言模型仅凭监测器的反馈就能推断出潜在监测器的检测规则，并通过放大激活编辑或秩1 LoRA有效规避检测，使监测器真阳性率从100%降至4%。
en_tdlr: LLMs can infer a latent monitor's decision rule from feedback alone and evade detection by amplifying activation edits (e.g., via a rank-1 LoRA), reducing the monitor's TPR from 100% to as low as 4%.
